section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the analytic strategy for a study examining how social interactions influence eating and body image using multilevel modeling with PROC MIXED in SAS 9.3. The analysis involves a hierarchical data structure with assessment days (level-1) nested within participants (level-2), examining both between-person and within-person predictors of body image and eating outcomes. Two sets of models are tested: one examining daily deviations in exposure to body-focused and non-body-focused others, and another examining changes in exposure from day to day while controlling for prior criterion variable levels.
